subject: Request: Executive approval — extended pilot + credit top-up (StellarHealth)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jim Hayes <jim.hayes@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension & credit request — StellarHealth POC

Hi Jim,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency numbers and the deployment options. Per our conversation, StellarHealth asked if we can: (1) extend the POC window from 30 to 90 days, and (2) add additional free credits to cover the higher token volume from your ingestion tests (~$10k).

Background: current PLG limits allow a single 30-day pilot and up to $5k in credits for first-time trials. This request exceeds both limits and will need one-off executive approval. The ask is a one-time exception to: extend the pilot to 90 days and top up credits by $12,000 (to ensure coverage of the full evaluation).

Attached: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (outline of deliverables), Redwood_POC_TopUp_Terms.docx (terms we propose to limit exposure), and your procurement questionnaire filled for our legal team.

Next steps I propose: I will escalate to Deal Desk/Ben for signoff and confirm any required procurement/PO language. If approved, we’ll prepare a short SOW addendum and DocuSign package.

Can you confirm procurement contact and the funding cadence (PO vs credit card)?

Best,
Kim
--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128


From: Jim Hayes <jim.hayes@stellarhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & credit request — StellarHealth POC

Kim,

Appreciate the quick follow. Procurement is looped at procurement@stellarhealth.com — they typically need a PO for any vendor spend, but will accept a short SOW + credit note for pilot activities if we commit to a procurement review at the pilot close.

Our product team wants 90 days because the ingestion ramp and clinical validation windows are longer than we originally estimated. The $12k top-up makes sense to cover token-heavy runs. We do need a firm commit that this is one-time and that any ongoing usage will move to a paid contract.

If you can get internal approval ASAP, we can start the extended ingestion tests on June 1.

Thanks,
Jim Hayes
Director of Product, StellarHealth
jim.hayes@stellarhealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension & credit request — StellarHealth POC (need exec decision)

Ben / Marissa,

Forwarding thread with StellarHealth. Request summary and recommended guardrails below — asking for an executive sign-off so we can respond to procurement and get the customer started June 1.

Summary of ask from customer:
- Extend existing POC window to 90 days (currently 30)
- Top up free credits by $12,000 to cover evaluation token usage
- Customer to provide PO; they prefer SOW+credit note approach for pilot

Why we should approve (business rationale):
- High strategic fit: EHR-connected product team, strong expansion potential across four hospital systems.
- Low cost to serve during pilot due to KV caching we can enable; predicted incremental infra cost ~ $2.8k for 90 days with the proposed SLOs.
- If we win, likely $150k+ ARR within 12 months (based on SAM and their pipeline).

Proposed constraints (risk mitigations):
1) One-time exception: explicitly documented in SOW addendum.
2) Usage cap: create token cap tied to the $12k credit; auto-throttle at 110% of cap and alert both parties.
3) No commit to future discounts beyond standard pricing; any discount requires separate approval.
4) Legal to approve the SOW addendum template; procurement to send PO before credit activation.

Attachments: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (with addendum section flagged), Redwood_POC_TopUp_Terms.docx (contains the cap and throttle language), StellarHealth_procurement_questionnaire.xlsx.

Decision requested: Approve one-time pilot extension + $12k credit top-up with the constraints above. If approved, I will prepare the DocuSign packet and coordinate with Legal.

Quick note: If you'd prefer a smaller credit and a shorter extension (e.g., 60 days + $7.5k), I can offer that as a compromise.

Thanks,
Kim
--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension & credit request — StellarHealth POC (need exec decision)

Kim / Marissa,

I approve the one-time 90-day extension and the $12,000 credit top-up on the conditions Kim listed. Please ensure the following before activating credits:
1) Legal signs the SOW addendum with explicit one-time exception language.
2) Procurement provides a PO or signed MSA addendum that references the credit note.
3) Finance records this as a one-off pilot credit (GL code: POC-CRED-27) so we can track consumables.
4) Limit set: implement the token cap and auto-throttle/alerts; engineering to confirm the throttle is in place before go-live.

Kim — once those boxes are checked, go ahead and send the DocuSign and cc Ben/Finance. Also cc Marissa on the SOW final version so CS can own the handoff.

Ben

VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
